title: These ETFs Promise to Magnify Returns—but Look Out Below | Dimensional
gist: Dimensional's Informed Investor podcast (Episode 64) page on single-stock leveraged ETFs; only a short teaser is available, which says they are popular but not appropriate for everyone and that speculation is unlikely to aid long-term wealth accumulation.

insights.claim: Dimensional says single-stock leveraged ETFs are popular but are not necessarily appropriate for every investor.
insights.speaker: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
insights.so_what: Treat leveraged single-stock ETF flows as a retail speculation signal, not a long-term allocation tool.
insights.quote: Leveraged ETFs are popular but aren't necessarily appropriate for every investor.

insights.claim: Dimensional holds that speculation is unlikely to aid long-term wealth accumulation.
insights.speaker: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
insights.so_what: Fits Dimensional's evidence-based, long-horizon positioning; expect advisor messaging to discourage leveraged products.
insights.quote: Speculation is unlikely to aid long-term wealth accumulation.

source_meta.author: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
